verdict.rationale: Gemini's privacy docs describe user controls over training use: you can turn off Keep Activity and delete activity at any time [gemini-docs-31]. Using audio and Gemini Live video or screenshares for model training is something you choose to allow [gemini-docs-37]. A separate help page says chats and uploaded files won't be used to improve generative AI models [gemini-docs-38]. missing for 10: an explicit statement tying the Keep Activity toggle to training exclusion, clarity on which accounts or settings the no-training guarantee in [gemini-docs-38] covers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
